thread:
Iris (Sales): handing off Orchid Cloud to CS 
Iris (Sales): signed 1yr, 60 seats, private deploy in eu-west-1. Requirements: SAML SSO, Splunk JSON-lines audit, EU-only data residency, and a reserved small GPU pool for peak windows. They called out renewal sensitivity if latency targets aren't met.

Nina (CS): thanks Iris 
Nina (CS): assigning Owen as CSM. Owen, i'll create the onboarding runbook and standing weekly cadence. Iris, quick snapshot of infra status and blockers?

Iris (Sales): legal and billing complete. Onboard kicked off. Pending: VPC peering (customer side), customer certs, KMS policy for EU key (they insist on regional KMS), Splunk HEC endpoint, and a small reserved pool request for 08:00-10:00 CET.

Owen (CSM): i'll own the runbook and be primary contact. Proposed runway: day0 network & provisioning, day2 SSO & KMS, day5 pilot with their 8 key prompts, day10 staged go-live. Acceptance: SSO working, Splunk ingestion OK with JSON-lines containing request_id and token_count, and median latency <320ms on pilot prompts under target load.

OnboardBot: provisioning status 
OnboardBot: VPC created; private control plane queued. Remaining tasks: vpn+peering, certs, KMS regional key, Splunk test ingestion. 4/9 complete.

Priya (Eng): reviewed the demo artifacts Iris attached 
Priya (Eng): reproducer shows streaming stalls around token ~680. We need request_id(s) from their environment to correlate with kernel/host traces. Short-term mitigation: try redwood-medium-quant for pilot, enable prefix cache for their main template, and reserve the requested small GPU pool for pilot windows. I'll create ENG-14222 if we get repros.

Sam (Support): opening CS ticket CS-9112 and tagging eng triage 
Sam (Support): please paste sanitized prompts and any request_id values. I'll monitor for reproducible traces and escalate on >2 repros in 24h.

Iris (Sales): sanitized log snippet (redacted):
2024-10-03T09:12:11Z request_id=oc-20241003-7 model=redwood-large seq=705 latency=1350ms step=kv_fetch stream_event=stall duration=1600ms
Their demo had ~900-token output.

Priya (Eng): thanks 
Priya (Eng): can Orchid run this curl from their env and paste the response header request_id? we need that to pull host traces:
```
curl -s -X POST https://private.redwood.eu/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<their-long-prompt>","stream":true}' -D - | head
```
If reproducible we'll open ENG-14222 and attach perf traces.

Owen (CSM): action items (owners):
- Owen: runbook + training schedule + standing invite (due 2024-10-08)
- Priya (Eng): triage stalls & recommend config/model change (due 2024-10-06)  ENG-14222 if repro'd
- Sam (Support): track CS-9112 and escalate per repro criteria
- Iris (Sales): deliver sanitized prompts + response request_ids
- OnboardBot/Infra: finish peering, certs, and provide VPN details
- Nina (CS): confirm weekly syncs and EU KMS rotation policy

Nina (CS): capturing enablement asks from customer: 1) EU private-deploy quickstart, 2) one-pager on quantization tradeoffs for their infra team, 3) runbook template with Splunk field mapping. They want the one-pager before the pilot.

Sam (Support): CS-9112 created, priority=high. Watchers: @Priya @Owen. Will link ENG-14222 when created.

Priya (Eng): preliminary suggestion: redwood-medium-quant + prefix cache for their template, bump streaming socket timeout to 60s on control plane, and validate reserved pool sizing. Will post a config diff after repro.

OnboardBot: vpn+peering complete (customer side pending). Splunk HEC test pending customer key. KMS key created in eu-west-1 (awaiting rotation policy from customer).

Owen (CSM): i'll update the runbook and post the link here. marking renewal-risk=monitor until latency acceptance is validated in staging. Closing the handoff; reopen if blockers appear before provisioning completes.
